title: Third-party code in a project lint-all
summary: A project lint-all leaves findings in vendored and library code out, says how many and why, and never hides your own shared units
intro: Read this to see which files lint-all treats as third-party, how to declare the exceptions, and how to show the skipped findings.

questions.ask: Why does lint-all not report findings in a third-party folder, and how do I see them?
